name: Intercontinental Koh Samui
insider_take: This luxury beachfront resort sits on pristine Taling Ngam Beach, offering unobstructed sunset views over the Gulf of Thailand's Five Islands archipelago.
whats_special: The resort features Thailand's largest infinity pool stretching 85 meters along the coastline, while its elevated clifftop location provides panoramic ocean vistas. Each villa boasts private pools and direct beach access, with some perched dramatically on rocky outcrops above the sea.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the resort's Air Bar - it's consistently ranked among Asia's best rooftop bars and offers unparalleled views of the famous Koh Samui golden hour over the Five Islands.
dont_miss: The traditional Thai longtail boat excursions to the mystical Five Islands (Koh Som, Koh Tean, etc.) just offshore, and the resort's signature spa treatments in open-air pavilions overlooking the Andaman Sea. The nearby Laem Sor Pagoda, a golden Buddhist temple extending into the ocean, is a 10-minute drive away.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on pristine Taling Ngam Beach
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with traditional Thai treatments
Multiple dining options featuring international and local cuisine
Spacious villas and suites with private pools and ocean views
cons: Remote location requires transportation to reach main attractions
